scope: Explicit frozen teacher60 research-profile packaging and full ESP32-P4 build integration. No model quality or hardware acceptance.

orphan-profile.expected_configuration_error: A wake calibration requires its model

initial_build.profile: explicit original v30; no device operation

initial_build_failure: Pre-existing Calculator format-truncation warning treated as error; same as earlier v30/Hi ESP research builds.

calculator_only_generated_ninja_exceptio.scope: Same Calculator-only generated Ninja exception as prior v30/Hi ESP builds; source and detector flags unchanged.

dependency_binding.limits: Resolver metadata adds existing decoder to direct_dependencies, normalizes one registry trailing slash and updates manifest_hash. No dependency version/component hash changed.

limits: Actual build uses the original v30 model/calibration through the explicit-profile CMake option. New joint-development report handling is covered by metadata fixtures, not an actual new candidate or P4 run.
Compiler exception affects only the pre-existing Calculator object in a private generated Ninja file; classifier/audio compiler flags and product source are unchanged.
Initial compiler failure is retained. A successful build with this exception is not a clean unmodified full-build result.
Firmware/ELF, SDK configuration, full build logs and resolver snapshots remain private; no firmware was flashed or published.
No PCM-speed, I2S/AEC/AGC, ordered wake FIFO, inference/event-policy, production board, new-development or final-data change.
Wake recognition, false wakes, phonetic latency, resources and long-call/reconnect comparison still require actual candidate evidence.
